name: MarketMind
tagline: A simulated market of AI trader agents to test your investment strategy before using real money.
problem: Beginner investors follow unresearched tips; the team cites high retail trading losses.
solution: An order-book simulation with price impact and volatility populated by LLM agents with distinct trading personalities; you add your strategy and watch it perform.
demo_moment: Team-described: drop your strategy into the simulated market and see the P&L.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “[Connor, Clark & Lunn] Best Financial Hack” among 169 submissions.
Uses multiple agent personalities as the market.

lessons: Agent simulations fit finance sponsors who value backtesting.
